crossRefs.note: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
If I had said, “I will speak thus”; behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.
Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob.
translations.bsb: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
translations.kjv: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
translations.asv: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, even Jacob. Selah
